name: USS Auto Parts, LLC
old_description: Specializing in inventory management and offering quality products, we are your "one stop shop" to keep your automotive service shop, tire shop, or quick lube up and running.
about:
Based in Seagrove, North Carolina, USS Auto Parts has supplied automotive repair shops, tire shops, and quick lubes for more than four decades. The company operates as a distributor and inventory-management partner, delivering parts directly to customers across central, southern, and mid‑western North Carolina as well as northern South Carolina.

USS Auto Parts stocks over 6,500 automotive part numbers from more than 30 brands, including Motorcraft, Purolator, Lucas, LubeGard, Trico, and Rain‑X. Its sales representatives visit accounts weekly, deliver needed items, and take inventory to replenish stock for the following week, effectively managing the supply chain for each shop.

The customer base consists of independent automotive service centers, tire retailers, and quick‑lube operations of varying sizes. By handling everything from hand cleaner and oil filters to wiper blades and small fittings, the company positions itself as a single source for routine maintenance and repair consumables.

The business emphasizes its weekly route service and hands‑on inventory management as its primary differentiator, aiming to keep shops stocked without requiring them to place individual orders.
